-- class: contract
-- name: attach-partition

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."regions_us" (like "public"."regions" including defaults including constraints including indexes excluding identity);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."regions_us" add constraint "okm_partition_bound" check ("region" in ('us')) not valid;

-- class: expand
-- kind: validate-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."regions_us" validate constraint "okm_partition_bound";

-- class: expand
-- kind: attach-partition
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."regions" attach partition "public"."regions_us" for values in ('us');

-- class: contract
-- kind: drop-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."regions_us" drop constraint "okm_partition_bound";
